parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence; the same-sex statute was repealed in 2022; Pride draws ~28,000, gay venues operate, and operator guidance describes a working scene. No documented police targeting of trans people, no trans-specific violence record, and the prison datum records no assaults. There is no state bathroom or facility ban — only social friction when a venue converted a toilet, which is hostility-framed friction, not universal exposure. Negatives are mostly resident-facing: surgery-gated legal recognition, a workplace law omitting gender identity, reported healthcare discrimination (the most visitor-relevant harm, though undocumented for visitors), and a hostile broadcast-code clause. No documented service refusals or border mistreatment of trans travellers; border practice, custody placement and facility enforcement remain open questions, weighted lightly. Substantial general safety and functioning institutions, but no documented trans-specific remedy or acceptance — just above the 0.55 tier.
